`data/ingredients/mapped/Sn-Glycerol_3-phosphate_Lithium_Salt.yaml` at main `4625afd492b6cf43e3b499d1425d2453d490009d` names **sn-Glycerol 3-phosphate lithium salt**, but its primary `cas:17989-41-2`, formula `C3H9O6P`, PubChem CID 439162, InChI and SMILES describe **sn-glycerol 3-phosphate without lithium**. The record maps `NARROW_MATCH` to CHEBI:15978.

Fresh primary database checks on 2026-11-01:

- [PubChem CAS 17989-41-2 query](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/17989-41-2/property/Title,MolecularFormula,InChI,InChIKey/JSON) returns CID 439162, sn-glycerol 3-phosphate, formula C3H9O6P.
- [ChEBI:15978](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:15978) carries this same free-acid formula and CAS.
- The record attributes CAS to `CultureBotHT compounds_to_cas.csv` and structure to automated PubChem backfill. The current occurrence statistics are 0/0. Its carbon-source role is explicitly a provisional name-pattern prediction, not form identity evidence.

Earlier #232/#732 work retained two free-acid names as `REJECTED_LABEL`, explicitly leaving identity unadjudicated. The canonical `other` still contains `Glycerol 3-phosphate` under #669's baseline. Neither synonym retirement nor the existing broad parent mapping validates a lithium-salt identity. Any correction must also preserve or explicitly reassess the provisional role and its content-bound evidence; no role approval is implied here.


Recommendation: trace the original CultureBotHT source/catalogue entry and an independently verified supplied form before choosing a replacement identity. If the salt name is supported, curate the salt-specific stable identifier and chemistry, retain the asymmetric parent and required identity rows, and refresh content-bound review receipts. If the supplied material was actually the parent, document that source-backed decision and reconcile the name/identity without losing raw source provenance. The automated name-derived CAS/chemistry is not independent evidence for choosing between these alternatives. Do not guess a replacement CAS, stereochemistry or merge.

Acceptance requires guarded curation/history, synchronized record/aggregate/SSSOM/label-index surfaces, preserved negative review holds, and native validation. No record edits are included in this finding. Neither target record is in the complete current #912 or #914 file list; shared aggregates and generated surfaces still require coordination.

This contradiction was listed as untracked in #887 and is related to the source-lookup risk in #235. Exact record-name and CAS issue searches found no dedicated open issue for this record. Historical #114 treated the parent mapping as acceptable; that does not validate the primary CAS identity. Keep #669 open pending this identity decision.

comments.body: Current native mapping-review check confirms all **three rows** owned by `data/ingredients/mapped/Sn-Glycerol_3-phosphate_Lithium_Salt.yaml` are already `WITHHOLD` (source positions 2524, 2525, 2526). This finding does not add or clear scientific approval. Preserve these holds through any future source-backed identity correction and native receipt regeneration; the present audit makes no record or identifier changes.

Approved decision for Step 4 of the ordered 2026-11-01 plan, after merged #1042 (`838d0c2627552b0094545ebb580b5bb9b1a84d57`): retain the distinct lithium-salt record with primary identifier `kgmicrobe.compound:sn-glycerol_3-phosphate_lithium_salt`, a broad mapping to CHEBI:15978 and its exact local registry row. Remove the false exact `cas:17989-41-2` identity row.

[ChEBI:15978](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/15978/) and [PubChem CID 439162](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/439162) describe the free acid, C3H9O6P, without lithium. [Sigma-Aldrich 94124](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/sigma/94124) explicitly names the lithium salt but gives variable Li content and a molecular weight on the free-acid basis. The retained successful primary captures support this distinction; an earlier timed-out raw HTML response is preserved as a failed retrieval, not evidence. No direct CAS Registry verification or fixed Li stoichiometry is claimed.

Set supplied_form to Sigma-Aldrich catalogue `94124`, CAS `17989-41-2`, form `lithium salt`, with the exact approved note: `free-acid CAS/FW; Li stoichiometry unstated`. Clear the active backfilled free-acid chemical-properties bundle, retaining its complete prior values and the existing eight-event history in the audit trail/preimage. Keep the existing provisional CARBON_SOURCE claim and evidence unchanged and OPEN; this identity correction does not approve it. Preserve the two existing rejected parent-name synonyms. Drop the published `Glycerol 3-phosphate` alias and retire only its corresponding Rule K allowance.

The scoped change will use the validated record writer and guarded publication, synchronize aggregates/exports, generate a native candidate and promote only this subject's two surviving rows, preserving the historical #390 explanation and exact prior validation stamps as provenance. The native receipt chain will preserve WITHHOLD on both surviving mappings and the unresolved role findings. No scientific approval will be inferred from this curation or structural review. The unchanged companion cohort will be refreshed through its maintained verifier.

Current preflight finds one active owner and no matching membership, rejection-ledger or unified rows; no changes to those source tables are proposed. The supported unified producer will still be replayed and checked for zero row changes before any provenance stamp. All counts and dependencies will be rechecked against this fresh base. Shared checkouts, protected qc-evidence/pin files and Intel work remain preserved. Full QC, tests, independent final-head review and required merge-queue checks precede the approved squash merge and owned-branch cleanup. This comment records the approved decision before implementation; no record edit is included.
